CASTING - Deux acteur.ices pour un court-métrage expérimental
Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Nous recherchons deux acteur.ices âgé.es de 20 à 30 ans pour une scène de baiser dans le cadre d’un court métrage expérimental indépendant.

La scène : 
Le film se compose d’une série de plans nocturnes tournés en pleine ville. La scène du baiser comprend deux plans en extérieur, de nuit, filmés à distance des personnages, sans gros plans.

Durée du tournage : 2 heures maximum
Rémunération : 50 € par personne
Lieu : région parisienne 

Aucun prérequis de genre, de taille ou d’origine ethnique. Les candidatures de couples ou de personnes qui se connaissent déjà sont les bienvenues, sans que cela soit obligatoire. 

Pour candidater : envoyez un mail à webehem@gmail.com, accompagné de votre book et/ou bande démo si vous en avez.

N’hésitez pas à partager cette annonce autour de vous !

Merci d’avance pour vos candidatures et vos partages.

MEN WANTED FOR A COPENHAGEN MUSIC FILM 🎬
I’m looking for a group of men to join two striking scenes in an ambitious, fashion-forward music film: a surreal clinic scene and a dark-red, burlesque-inspired orgy tableau.

No dance experience or special skills needed—just be open to trying some simple, choreographed movement and bringing your presence. The scenes will be carefully staged, with movement and boundaries discussed together in advance.

Filming in Copenhagen, 16–17 November. Interested? DM me and I’ll send you the details ❤️

URGENT CASTING CALL for Production 2 of The Black Widows Pilot
3-day film shoot on the 15th-17th November 2026 in Coventry/Rugby

We have a micro budget so will provide lunch and cover travel expenses

 

Our current cast includes makeup-artists, director of photography, 1st assistant director and script supervisor alongside our cast of actors and actresses.

 

We have the main cast recruited but have some additional exciting roles available

 

We are searching for some talented actresses and actors to bring some of these compelling characters to life on our BLACK WIDOWS production. 

Set against a decade of betrayal, ambition, and bloody survival, Black Widows follows a fierce all-female crew operating in the shadows of a massive criminal empire.

The Character Profiles are below;

1. CEE (Late Teens/ Early Twenties) (2 scenes (1 day) This is an LGBT role

* Ethnicity & Look: Mixed Race, Latino or ethnically ambiguous 

* The Character: A gifted athlete and musician who plays Toya’s love interest. Cee possesses strong morals, fierce internal strength, and a rare, unyielding conscience forged by her unique background and upbringing. 

* Vibe: Captivating, athletic, soulful, and morally grounded amidst the chaos.

2. KIDADA’S FRIEND ALYSSA (Age Flexible / Adult) (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Slender White female with curly hair.

* The Character: A gritty, street-level drug addict who features briefly in the storyline. Desperate and unpredictable, she ultimately squats in Kidada’s home while Kidada is away in rehab. 

* Vibe: Raw, vulnerable, authentic, and emotionally charged.

3. VIVIAN (One scene – Half a day)

* Demographic: Black or Mixed-Race Woman, 50s to Early 60s.

* The Role: Vivian is a hardened, razor-sharp, and deeply complex woman. A recovering alcoholic, she holds the heaviest title in the room: she is the mother of Brenda James, the notorious, ruthless "mother of the underworld." 

* The Vibe: Vivian is hateful, resentful, brilliant, and fiercely intelligent. She is a multi-layered powerhouse who commands every single scene she is in. If you love playing complex, unapologetic characters with dark depths and sharp edges, Vivian is the role for you.

4. BEN (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 30s Male.

* The Character: A low level street runner who is a known criminal

5. MARCUS (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 40s-50s Male.

* The Character: A local unstable sleazeball who hustles and does whatever it takes to get on in life

6. Claire (One scene 2-3 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race (Age flexible female)

* The Character: A kind and friendly support worker who works at the drug and substance misuse clinic

EXTRA’s roles are available in addition to the above roles 

BENEFITS OF BEING PART OF THE PRODUCTION

* Official IMDb Credit: Boost your industry profile with a major television credit.

* CV & Acting Portfolio Development: Work alongside top-tier talent and crew, capturing stellar footage and high-end broadcast-quality material for your showreel post the production’s release.

* This production comes with a potential opportunity to reprise your role in a massive, upcoming 14-part TV series extension subject to investment funding! 

Please DM me for further details and to apply for the roles.

🎭 THERE’S STILL ROOM FOR YOU IN THE CRUCIBLE! ❤️

Come be part of something meaningful!
Our auditions are almost full, but there are still so many ways to get involved in our exciting community theatre production of The Crucible, coming to Ottawa’s Gladstone Theatre in February 2027!
Whether you’ve never set foot in a theatre or have years of professional experience, we’d love to hear from you!
No experience necessary! And to those with experience, knowledge, and expertise to share, your volunteer contributions would be enormously valued.
We also believe this experience has something wonderful to offer everyone who participates.

❤️ MORE THAN A PLAY
Arthur Miller wrote The Crucible in 1953 as a parable for McCarthyism and the fear, accusations, and political persecution of his time.
We believe it can also serve as a powerful parable for the times we’re living in today.
Through this production, we’ll explore questions about fear, power, conformity, courage, conscience, and what happens when communities turn against one another.
We’re not here to tell people what to think. We’re creating space to think, question, discuss, and explore together.
And, of course, to create some wonderful theatre along the way!

🌟 HOW CAN YOU GET INVOLVED?
🎭 Onstage: Non-speaking roles, ensemble performers, and understudies.

🎨 Creative & Technical: Sets, props, costumes, construction, painting, hair and makeup, lighting, sound, and backstage crew.

🎬 Production Support: Stage management, rehearsal assistance, volunteer coordination, transportation, logistics, photography, and video.

📣 Marketing & Community: Social media, postering, publicity, creating our online program, finding sponsors, connecting with local TV, radio, newspapers and podcasts, and community outreach.

❤️ Special Opportunities: Helping organize our intergenerational performance for seniors and high school students, supporting special lobby activities, accessibility and participant support, and other helping hands!

Have a talent or idea we haven’t mentioned? Tell us!

📅 COME MEET US!
Tuesday, October 20 at 6:00 p.m.

📍 All Saints Westboro
347 Richmond Road, Ottawa
This is an opportunity for people interested in non-speaking roles and behind-the-scenes involvement to meet us and learn more about the production.

Please email us in advance to let us know you’re coming. No drop-ins, please!

💌 connect@nataliefraser.ca
Include your name, phone number, areas of interest, any experience or skills you’d like to share, your general availability, and whether you’ll attend October 20.

Can’t make October 20? That’s absolutely fine! Email us anyway, and we’ll invite you to join us on November 1.
🗓️ WHAT ABOUT THE COMMITMENT?
Rehearsals will generally take place on Wednesdays and Sundays, but not everyone will be needed every week. There will also be some full-cast and crew days, with details shared as we develop the rehearsal schedule.

❤️ WHY BE PART OF IT?
Because community theatre is about more than putting on a show.
It’s about people of different ages, backgrounds, and experiences coming together. Sharing skills. Learning new things. Building friendships. Challenging ourselves. Having fun. And creating something that matters.
Whether you come to learn, to share your expertise, to meet new people, or because the themes of this play speak to you, we hope you’ll find something meaningful in the experience too.
The Crucible was a parable for Miller’s time. What might it reveal about ours?
Let’s explore that together!

🎭 THE CRUCIBLE
February 17–20, 2027
The Gladstone Theatre, Ottawa
Unedited Woman Productions
Come for the theatre. Stay for the community. Be part of the conversation. ❤️

#TheCrucible #OttawaTheatre #CommunityTheatre #OttawaVolunteers #UneditedWomanProductions #TheGladstone #VolunteerOttawa

items.text:
**JOHNSON PARANORMAL**

**Casting Call**

**Casting Director **– C. Patricio 

**Producers **– Ian David Nsenga, Maritama Carlson, Jeff Schellenberg

**Director **– Jeff Schellenberg

**Shoot Dates** - Nov. 19-22, 2026

**Compensation **- $200/Day

**Filming Locations** – New Westminster & Maple Ridge, B.C.

**Union Status **- Open to UBCP Union and Non-Union Performers

 

**Synopsis **– An edgy, laugh-out-loud, horror-comedy web-series about three half-brothers who open a ghost hunting start-up out of their aunt’s garage. Each episode brings a procedural-esque investigation as the crew tackles a wild new supernatural mystery.

**Tone**: Ghostbusters meets Always Sunny in Philadelphia. 

 

**CHARACTERS**

 

**FRED**** **Lead (30s/male) Fred is effortlessly handsome, incredibly chill, and a natural social butterfly. He possesses a genius-level EQ, making him instantly likable and a massive hit with the ladies—though his disorganization and inability to say no to a good time recently backfired, leaving him an ex-girlfriend turned nightmare stalker.

Brilliant, adaptable, and a victim of vanity, Fred holds a degree in chemical engineering. However, after AI took his corporate job, he decided to pivot to his childhood dream of launching his own ghost exterminating business. This unconventional career move finally allows him to monetize a deep, lifelong passion for the paranormal.

[Skills: Superb comedic timing. Strong improvisation skills are a major asset. Fred needs to feel grounded, quick on his feet, and effortlessly witty. Open to any ethnicity.]

 

**KENNY**** **Lead (30/male) Kenny is a laid-back, jack-of-all-trades with a brilliant mechanical mind and endless blue-collar connections. He’s a fisherman by trade, but with the local fishing market collapsing, he’s had to pivot to a brand-new venture: ghost exterminating.

Kenny loves a cold beer (frequently enjoyed on the job), finding clever workarounds to hard labor (which others might call laziness), and pulling a good prank. He’s a natural mentor to Delmer, but often clashes with Justin’s academic methods. He’s comfortable in his own skin, rough around the edges, and fiercely loyal.

[Skills: Excellent Physical Comedy & Distinct Character Work: We need an actor who can bring a strong, specific physical presence and comedic timing to the screen. Strong improv skills are a major asset to capture his quick-witted, easygoing banter. A natural beer belly or a burly, blue-collar physique is a huge plus. Open to any ethnicity.] 

 

**JUSTIN**** **Lead (30s/male) A brilliant but tightly wound IT whiz who walked away from tech to chase a childhood dream with his two half-brothers of opening a ghost-hunting startup. With a math PhD and software background, Justin is a true polymath, a Shakespeare nut, and a sarcastic history buff who treats life as a quest to expand his brainpower. What he has in academic genius, he completely lacks in street smarts. He’s thrilled to finally be his own boss (sort of) and step into a new chapter of personal freedom. 

[Skills: Comedic delivery. Ability to improvise is an asset. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**DELMER**** **Co-Lead (18/male) Delmer is a friendly, sweet, genuine, and wide-eyed Hutterite runaway standing on the edge of a massive new world. Built with a solid, farm-raised physicality but carrying a deep, untouched innocence, he has spent his entire life in a strict communal society. Now, he is chasing a burning yearning to experience everything he’s never seen: skyscrapers piercing the clouds, bustling shopping malls, roaring sports cars, helicopters, the vast ocean and the electric pulse of big-city nightclubs.

This role is a powerhouse opportunity for an actor to portray a profound coming-of-age journey. We are looking for someone who can beautifully balance a strong physical presence with an endearing, vulnerable naivety as Delmer steps into his chaotic, exciting next chapter. [Actor must be 18+. Preference for Caucasian ethnicity]

 

**LILY**** **Co-Lead (30/female) Lily is cute, witty, and fiercely independent. After walking away from a cushy corporate ladder and a highly judgmental family, she traded her high heels for work boots to chase her dream: running her own hobby farm.

She’s earnest, deeply down-to-earth, and entirely back-to-nature—but passion doesn't pay the tuition for her agricultural courses. Enter Johnson Paranormal. To fund her late-night studying, she’s taken a gig as the agency's newest secretary. Balancing spreadsheets, ghost sightings, and goat feed, Lily is a grounded force in a chaotic, supernatural world. [Preference for Chinese/East Asian ethnicity]

 

**Ms. GUNDERSON** (80/female) She’s your friendly neighborhood grandma. She’s sweet, independent, slightly oblivious, devoted to her baking and prized cactus, and isn't afraid to unwind with a THC gummy. But her cozy world is turned upside down by an overwhelming ghost presence that's taking over her home.

[We are looking for an actress who can balance warmth and genuine vulnerability, as she faces the supernatural and keeps an embarrassing secret. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**TONY**** **(40s/male) Tony is the ultimate contradiction: a chill, uber-organized, and ruthlessly violent drug importer who genuinely believes in giving back to his community. When he isn't managing high-stakes international logistics or handling business with cold precision, he’s passionately funding local charities and cheering on neighborhood sports teams. He runs his empire like a Fortune 500 company, but his meticulously ordered life has just been thrown into complete chaos.

An annoying, chaotic ghost has moved into his estate, wreaking absolute havoc on his sanity and his bottom line. Tony is a man used to eliminating his problems—but how do you eliminate something you can’t kill?

[Seeking an actor who can balance a grounded, dangerous intensity with a relaxed, dry charm. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**How to Apply**

Please submit your headshot, resume, and demo reel (if available) to:
**Johnsonparanormalshow@gmail.com**

*Please include the character name you are submitting for in the email subject line (e.g., "Submission: FRED - [Your Name]").*

**KENNY**** **Lead (30/male) Kenny is a laid-back, jack-of-all-trades with a brilliant mechanical mind and endless blue-collar connections. He’s a fisherman by trade, but with the local fishing market collapsing, he’s had to pivot to a brand-new venture: ghost exterminating.

Kenny loves a cold beer (frequently enjoyed on the job), finding clever workarounds to hard labor (which others might call laziness), and pulling a good prank. He’s a natural mentor to Delmer, but often clashes with Justin’s academic methods. He’s comfortable in his own skin, rough around the edges, and fiercely loyal.

[Skills: Excellent Physical Comedy & Distinct Character Work: We need an actor who can bring a strong, specific physical presence and comedic timing to the screen. Strong improv skills are a major asset to capture his quick-witted, easygoing banter. A natural beer belly or a burly, blue-collar physique is a huge plus. Open to any ethnicity.] 

 

**JUSTIN**** **Lead (30s/male) A brilliant but tightly wound IT whiz who walked away from tech to chase a childhood dream with his two half-brothers of opening a ghost-hunting startup. With a math PhD and software background, Justin is a true polymath, a Shakespeare nut, and a sarcastic history buff who treats life as a quest to expand his brainpower. What he has in academic genius, he completely lacks in street smarts. He’s thrilled to finally be his own boss (sort of) and step into a new chapter of personal freedom. 

[Skills: Comedic delivery. Ability to improvise is an asset. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**DELMER**** **Co-Lead (18/male) Delmer is a friendly, sweet, genuine, and wide-eyed Hutterite runaway standing on the edge of a massive new world. Built with a solid, farm-raised physicality but carrying a deep, untouched innocence, he has spent his entire life in a strict communal society. Now, he is chasing a burning yearning to experience everything he’s never seen: skyscrapers piercing the clouds, bustling shopping malls, roaring sports cars, helicopters, the vast ocean and the electric pulse of big-city nightclubs.

This role is a powerhouse opportunity for an actor to portray a profound coming-of-age journey. We are looking for someone who can beautifully balance a strong physical presence with an endearing, vulnerable naivety as Delmer steps into his chaotic, exciting next chapter. [Actor must be 18+. Preference for Caucasian ethnicity]

 

**LILY**** **Co-Lead (30/female) Lily is cute, witty, and fiercely independent. After walking away from a cushy corporate ladder and a highly judgmental family, she traded her high heels for work boots to chase her dream: running her own hobby farm.

She’s earnest, deeply down-to-earth, and entirely back-to-nature—but passion doesn't pay the tuition for her agricultural courses. Enter Johnson Paranormal. To fund her late-night studying, she’s taken a gig as the agency's newest secretary. Balancing spreadsheets, ghost sightings, and goat feed, Lily is a grounded force in a chaotic, supernatural world. [Preference for Chinese/East Asian ethnicity]

 

**Ms. GUNDERSON** (80/female) She’s your friendly neighborhood grandma. She’s sweet, independent, slightly oblivious, devoted to her baking and prized cactus, and isn't afraid to unwind with a THC gummy. But her cozy world is turned upside down by an overwhelming ghost presence that's taking over her home.

[We are looking for an actress who can balance warmth and genuine vulnerability, as she faces the supernatural and keeps an embarrassing secret. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**TONY**** **(40s/male) Tony is the ultimate contradiction: a chill, uber-organized, and ruthlessly violent drug importer who genuinely believes in giving back to his community. When he isn't managing high-stakes international logistics or handling business with cold precision, he’s passionately funding local charities and cheering on neighborhood sports teams. He runs his empire like a Fortune 500 company, but his meticulously ordered life has just been thrown into complete chaos.

An annoying, chaotic ghost has moved into his estate, wreaking absolute havoc on his sanity and his bottom line. Tony is a man used to eliminating his problems—but how do you eliminate something you can’t kill?

[Seeking an actor who can balance a grounded, dangerous intensity with a relaxed, dry charm. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**How to Apply**

Please submit your headshot, resume, and demo reel (if available) to:
**Johnsonparanormalshow@gmail.com**

*Please include the character name you are submitting for in the email subject line (e.g., "Submission: FRED - [Your Name]").*

**Kleinwüchsige Darstellerin gesucht für „Getting In", Kunsthalle Wien**

 

Honorar: EUR 700,- (Werkvertrag, inklusive aller Proben und der Aufführung)

Bewerbungsfrist: 23. Oktober 2026, 23:59 Uhr

Aufführung: 17. November 2026, 19:00 Uhr, Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz

 

„Getting In" ist ein neues Lustspiel des kanadischen Regisseurs Harkeerat Mangat für eine Darstellerin. Es erzählt die Geschichte von Maria, die von der Pflege ihrer Mutter nach Hause zurückkehrt und feststellt, dass der Zugangscode zu ihrem Wohnhaus geändert wurde. Ausgesperrt muss sie ihre exzentrischen Nachbar*innen davon überzeugen, sie hereinzulassen. Premiere am 17. November 2026 um 19:00 Uhr in der Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz.

 

Alle Details: https://kunsthallewien.at/veranstaltung/performance-harkeerat-mangat-getting-in

**Die Rolle: Maria**

 

Wir suchen eine kleinwüchsige Frau, ca. 100 bis 150 cm, ca. 35 bis 65 Jahre, für die Rolle der Maria, die einzige Live-Rolle des Stücks.

 

Das Bühnenbild ist ein Modell-Wohnhaus von drei Metern Höhe, und die Bewohner*innen, die Maria zu überzeugen versucht, sind sehr klein. Die Dimensionen des Stücks funktionieren nur mit einer kleinwüchsigen Darstellerin.

 

Marias Sprache ist für das Publikum nicht verständlich. Der Text muss daher nicht auswendig gelernt werden. Die Bewegungsabläufe müssen einstudiert werden, es gibt darin aber Raum für Improvisation.

 

Da eine erfundene Sprache immer nach jener Sprache klingt, aus der sie kommt, suchen wir jemanden, der österreichisches Deutsch als Muttersprache oder auf muttersprachlichem Niveau spricht. Das Kauderwelsch soll österreichisch klingen.

 

Schauspielerfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen auf jedem Erfahrungsstand, auch von Personen, die noch nie auf einer Bühne gestanden sind.

 

**Zeitplan**

 

Bewerbungsfrist: 23. Oktober 2026, 23:59 Uhr

Vorsprechen: Woche ab 26. Oktober 2026, via Zoom

Erste Probe: Wochenende 30. Oktober bis 1. November 2026, vor Ort

Zweite Probe: Woche ab 9. November 2026

Endprobe auf der Bühne: 17. November 2026, Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz

Aufführung: 17. November 2026, 19:00 Uhr

 

Stundenausmaß: drei Proben à maximal vier Stunden sowie die Aufführung, gesamt ca. 14 Stunden.

** **

**Engagement und Honorar**

 

EUR 700,- gesamt auf Werkvertragsbasis, inklusive aller Proben und der Aufführung. Das Honorar orientiert sich an der Honoraruntergrenze der IG Freie Theaterarbeit. Auftraggeber: Harkeerat Mangat.

 

**Bewerbung**

 

Bitte schick bis 23. Oktober 2026 eine E-Mail an casting@harkeeratmangat.com mit:

 

1. Einem Foto von dir. Ein Handyfoto genügt völlig, es muss kein professionelles Foto sein.

2. Deinem Namen, Alter und deiner Körpergröße.

3. Ob du schon einmal gespielt hast, und wenn ja, kurz was. „Keine Erfahrung" ist eine völlig gute Antwort.

4. Ob du österreichisches Deutsch sprichst und ob es deine Alltagssprache ist.

 

Mehr braucht es nicht. Kein Lebenslauf, kein Showreel und kein Motivationsschreiben.

 

**Über den Künstler **

 

Harkeerat Mangat (geb. 1990 in Vancouver) ist kanadischer Filmemacher und Theaterregisseur und lebt in Wien. Sein Film „Fürstenplatz" und sein großangelegtes Theaterprojekt „Sommer-Kultur-Fest" wurden mit dem Vordemberge-Gildewart-Preis ausgezeichnet. Einzelausstellungen hatte er im Bonner Kunstverein, in der Stiftung Museum Insel Hombroich und im kjubh Kunstverein; Performances zeigte er im Kunstverein Gartenhaus, Wien, und in der Zweigstelle Capitain, Neapel.

 

Er entwirft Szenarien, innerhalb derer die Darsteller*innen frei improvisieren, und arbeitet sowohl mit professionellen als auch mit nicht-professionellen Schauspieler*innen.

 

KONTAKT

 

Harkeerat Mangat

casting@harkeeratmangat.com

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

I am an actor/writer Seeking a director for the short film "Burst". The film is an independent short drama that blends sharp dialogue, mystery, paranoia, and grounded realism into an intense character study about trauma, fractured relationships, trust under pressure, and escalating consequences.
I am an actor/writer Seeking a director for the short film "Burst". The film is an independent short drama that blends sharp dialogue, mystery, paranoia, and grounded realism into an intense character study about trauma, fractured relationships, trust under pressure, and escalating consequences.

This is unpaid and probably ideal for a student or someone looking to cut their teeth, but I'm looking for someone to help me bring this project to life. I am happy to give a lot of creative freedom and this is by no means the final draft. DM me or email if you're interested and I'll send you the script! justinpowers7@gmail.com.

සිනමාවේ පාතාල කවියාගේ (The Poet of Cinema's Underworld)  හැඟුම්බර ප්‍රකාශනය
The Irishman
#################################

Martin Scorasese කියන්නෙ පාතාල ලෝකයේ මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මක කැඩපත (The Psychological Mirror of the Underworld) විදිහට හඳුන්වනවා. ඒ  අතරෙම 
 Jean-Pierre Melville අධ්‍යක්ෂවරයාට කියන අන්වර්ථ නාමය (The poet of Cinema's Underworld) ලෙස ම සමහර විචාරකයො Martin Scorasese වත් හඳුන්වනවා.

අඳුරු වීදි වල භයංකර සිද්ධි ඇතුළෙ තියන චිත්තවේගී ගැඹුර (emotional depth) සංවේදී විදිහට ඉදිරිපත් කරන්නට සමත් Scorasese ගේ "The Irishman" (2019) තුළින් දැකපු විශේෂ ම දේවල් කිහිපයක් විමසන එක තමයි මගේ මෙි ලියමනේ අරමුණ.

තේමාව සහ කතා සාරය 
##################

The Irishman කියන්න Martin Scorsese ගෙ නිර්මාණ අතර මිත්‍රත්වය සහ පාවාදීම (Loyalty vs. Betrayal), තමන්ට රැකවරණය දුන් පාතාල කල්ලියට ඇති පක්ෂපාතිත්වය සහ තමන්ගේ හොඳම මිතුරන්  අතරින් එකෙකු තෝරා ගැනීමට සිදුවීමේ දී ඇතිවන මානසික ගැටුම මූලික වුණ චිත්‍රපටයක්. 
කාලය සහ පසුතැවීම (Time and Regret), ජීවිතයේ තරුණ කාලයේ බලය, මුදල් සහ ප්‍රචණ්ඩත්වය පසුපස හඹාගොස්, අවසානයේ මහලු වියේදී තනි වීම වගේ ම තමන් කළ වැරදි ගැන පසුතැවීමට සිදුවීම මෙහි ප්‍රධානම තේමාව වෙනවා.

සරලවම කිවහොත්, මේක පාතාල ලෝකයේ අපරාධ, දේශපාලන කුමන්ත්‍රණ සහ ඒ මගින් ජීවිතයක් විනාශ වී යන විදිහ පෙන්වන ශෝකී (Tragic) කතාවක්.

දෙවන ලෝක යුද්ධයෙ දි ඉතා පහසුවෙන් හා උපක්‍රමශීලීව ප්‍රතිවාදීන් ඝාතනය කරල පුරුදු ෆ්‍රෑන්ක් ශීරන් (Frank Sheeran) කියන ට්‍රක් රථ රියදුරා පාතාල කල්ලියක නායකයෙක් වන රසල් බෆලිනෝ (Russell Bufalino) ළඟ ප්‍රබල මැරයෙක් හා කුළී ඝාතකයෙක් බවට පත්වෙනව. ඒ වගේම Frank, ඇමරිකාවේ ප්‍රසිද්ධම වෘත්තීය සමිති නායකයෙකු වන ජීමි හොෆා (Jimmy Hoffa) ගේ සමීපතම ආරක්ෂකයා සහ හොඳම මිත්‍රයා වෙනවා. ඒත් කාලයත් එක්ක ජීමි හොෆා සහ පාතාල කල්ලි අතර ඇතිවන ගැටුම නිසා, තමන්ගේම හොඳම මිතුරාව ඝාතනය කරන දරුණු කොන්ත්‍රාත්තුව Frank ට භාර ගන්ඩ වෙනවා.
ඒ මරණය සිද්ධ කළාට පස්සෙ මේ අප්‍රමාණව මිනීමැරුම් කරපු Frankගෙ හෘද සාක්ෂිය කතා කරන්ඩ ගන්නවා.

නිර්මාණ දායකත්වය
################

Martin Scarasese ගේ චිත්‍රපටයක් වන මේක
චාල්ස් බ්‍රෑන්ඩ් (Charles Brandt)
 ලියූ "I Heard You Paint Houses"  නවකථාව ඇසුරෙන් තමයි නිර්මාණය වෙන්නේ.
තිර රචනය (Screenplay): ස්ටීවන් සේලියන් (Steven Zaillian) කරන අතරෙ
කැමරාකරණය (Cinematography): රොඩ්රිගෝ ප්‍රීටෝ (Rodrigo Prieto) කරනවා.

කෙසේ වෙතත් විචාරකයන්ට සැරට සහ රහට පිළිතුරු දෙමින් Scorasese කියා තිබෙන්නේ, 
හැඟීම්වල සමුච්චිත බලපෑම (Cumulative Effect) වැදගත් බවයි. එනම්, චිත්‍රපටයේ අවසානය ප්‍රේක්ෂකයාට තදින් ම දැනීමට නම්, ඔවුන් මුළු කතාවම එක දිගට නැරඹිය යුතුයි. චිත්‍රපටයේ අවසන් මිනිත්තු 20 තුළ දැනෙන තනිකම සහ ශෝකය ප්‍රේක්ෂකයාට දැනෙන්නේ ඔවුන් ඊට පෙර ගත වූ පැය කිහිපයක සිදුවීම් සියල්ල එක දිගට අත්වින්දොත් විතරක් බව ඔහු අපූරුවට පැහැදිලි කළා.

ව්‍යාකණය පැරද වූ  emitional මොහොත
##############################

දවසක් කතා කරන්ඩ පුළුවං දේ තියෙද්දි චිත්‍රපට ගැන උනන්දු වෙන කෙනෙකුට වටින අපූරු ම තැනක් ගැන පළමුවෙන් ම කතා කරන්ඩ හිතුණා. 

ඉහත කී පරිදි අවසානයෙ තම මිත්‍රයා Hoff  මරණ Frank ට Hoff ගෙ බිරිඳගෙන් දුරකථන ඇමතුමක් එනවා. ඒක ගත්ත ගමන් ඇය තම නම කියනවා. බිරිඳගෙ නම ඇහුණ වහා ම, මිනිස් ඝාතන, මදුරුවන් මරණ තරම් සරල වෙලා තිබුණ Frank(Robert De Niro) එතන දි  අතිශය සංවේදී වෙනවා.
ඒ්ත් එතන සිනමා භාෂාවෙ කියන  Jump Cut එකක්  අමු අමුවේ  Frank ගෙ මුහුණ උඩ ම නැවත අමුණන බව අපට පේනවා. ලොවක් දිනූ සංස්කාරකවරිය Thelma මෙහෙම කරන්නෙ ලොවක් හෙල්ලූ Scorasese අධ්‍යක්ෂවරයා⁣ හා එක්වයි. මේක විචාරක, රසික පර්ශදය හොඳට ම කළඹන වැඩක් වුණා..ඇත්තටම, කුමන හෝ හේතුවකට  ඒ දුරකථන ඇමතුමේ ප්‍රතිචාරය අඛණ්ඩ ව නොවී, වෙනම shot එකක් විදිහට shoot වෙලා...ඒ්ත් පසුබට නොවී එම පිමි ඡේදනය කර, තාක්ෂණයට වඩා emotion එක වැදගත් යැයි සංස්කාරකවරිය පිළිගනිද්දි අධ්‍යක්ෂවරයා කිව්වෙ මෙහෙම එකක්.
"මෙතන දි මට De Niro ගෙ පරිණත හා emotional  රංගනය ආරක්ෂා කරන්ඩ වෙනවා. (Preserving Performance)
ඒ අපූරු අවස්ථාව  සම්මුතිවාදී වෙලා විනාස කරන්ඩ මට බැහැ. ආපහු shoot කරත් ඒක ආයෙ ගන්ඩ බැහැ..ඒ වගේ ම මෙතනදි ප්‍රේක්ෂකයා අභියෝගයට ලක් කරන්ඩ වෙනවා. (Challenging the Audience)  මං  ප්‍රේක්ෂකයා හුරතල් කරලා, දෙන දෙයක් ඒ අයට ගිල්ලවන්ඩ ආස නෑ.. VFX වලින් තාක්ෂණික අවුල වහන්ඩ  හරි Smoothing කරල විශිෂ්ඨ රංගනයක් නැති කරල දාන්ඩ හරි මට අවශ්‍ය නෑ, emotion එකයි මෙතන මට වැදගත්" 

මට අනුව නං මේක ඓතිහාසික ප්‍රකාශයක්, අද්වීතීය තීරණයක්. තාක්ෂණයට ම පන්න පන්න නිර්මාණ කරන අයට සහ ඒක ම මූලිකව බලන අපේ රටේ TV චැනල්  වලටත්  සමහර ජූරි වලටත් මේක හොඳ ම පාඩමක් හා ආදර්ශයක්.

• Carpentry කියන්නේ,  මිනී පෙට්ටි සෑදීම හෙවත් ඝාතනයෙන් පසු ඉතිරි වන සාක්ෂි සහ මළ සිරුර කිසිවෙකුටත් හොයාගත නොහැකි වන විදිහට විනාශ කරල  "පිරිසිදු" කිරීම (Disposing of the bodies / Cleaning up the mess).

සඟවන ලද මරණයේ බියකරු බව වගේ ම පාතාලයන්ගේ මිනීමැරුමේ කලාව සිනමාත්මකව හෙළි කිරීම රචකයාගේ හා අධ්‍යක්ෂ ⁣Scorasese ගේ තවත් විශේෂත්වයක්. මෙහි යටි පෙළ(Subtext) අපට කියන දේ අතිශය වැදගත් බවත් සිහි කළ යුතුයි.

බිහිසුණු ඝාතන අවසානයේ
හුදෙකලා කම්පනය
#####################

චිත්‍රපටය පුරා ඇහෙන වෙඩි ශබ්දවලට වඩා, එහි අවසානයේ ෆ්‍රෑන්ක් ශීරන් මුහුණ දෙන   පැවැත්ම පිළිබඳ හිස්බව (Despair Existential) සහ අවසාන හුදකලාව(Terminal Solitude ) ප්‍රේක්ෂක හදවත් වල දරුණු ලෙස කම්පනයක් ඇති කරනව.  ඒක බිහිසුණු අපරාධකාරයෙකුගේ වීරකම නෙමෙයි, හැඟීම් සහ මනුෂ්‍යත්වය පාවා දුන් මිනිසෙකුගේ අතිශය ශෝකී අවසානය කියලයි මට හිතෙන්නෙ.
ඒ අනුව, පෝළිමට මිනී මරණ පාතාල නායකයින්, කුළී මිනීමරුවන් උත්කර්ෂයට නංවන නිර්මාණ බොහොමයක් අතරේ The Irishman අතිශය සුවිශේෂීයි. ඒ මන්ද යත්, මේ විදිහට කුළියට මිනී මරන්නන් ඇතුළෙත් ඉන්නෙත් මිනිස්සු නේද  කියන ඇත්ත අපූරුවට එළදැක්වීම නිසයි.

දියණියගෙන් ප්‍රතික්ෂේප වූ අනවරත කුළී ඝාතකයා
###############################

කෙටියෙන් මම කියත හොත්, Frank ගේ අවසන් දර්ශන වල පෙන්වන්නෙ මුළු ජීවිත කාලයම ඉහළින් ලැබෙන අණට  මිනිසුන් පෝළිමට  මැරුවත්, තමංගෙ ම දියණියගේ නිහඬ ප්‍රතික්ෂේප කිරීම හමුවේ  ඔහු සම්පූර්ණයෙන්ම අසරණ වූ මිනිහෙක්.  දියණිය පෙගීගේ නිහඬතාවයේ බලපෑම Frank ට කිසි සේත් ම  දරාගන්ඩ බැරි බව පැහැදිලිව පේනවා. ඇගේ නිහඬතාවයේ බලපෑම Frank ව වගේ ම ප්‍රේක්ෂක අපවත් කම්පනයට පත්කරනවා. අවසානයෙ දි දියණිය ව හමුවෙලා සමාව ගන්ඩ ඇය සේවය කරන බැංකුවට යන Frank ට ඇගෙන් ලැබෙන නිහඬ, අමුතු ප්‍රතිචාරය ව්ශේෂයි. "Counter closed" කියන පුවරුව තබා තම කවුන්ටරයෙන් නිහඬව ම යන දියණිය දෙස බලන Frankගේ චිත්තාවේගය හා හැඟීම මවන්නට Robert De Niro දක්වන emotional, subtle  Acting විභවතාවය අපූරුයි. ඒක අති සියුම් වගේ ම  තව පැත්තකින් අපට අභ්‍යන්තරව තදින් ස්පර්ශ වෙන පුදුම Palpable tention  එකක්.

බාගෙට ඇරපු දොර ගෙනෙන රූපකය(Metaphor)
####################################

 අවසන් අදියරේ දි Niro ගේ මුහුණේ ඇති වන සියුම් හැඟීම් ප්‍රකාශන    (Micro-expressions)
දෑස් තුළින් මතු වන  යටපත් කළ දැඩි වේදනාව (Subdued Agony ) සහ වරදකාරී හැඟීම ප්‍රේක්ෂකයා භීතියට වගේ ම අතිශය සංවේදී කම්පනයකට පත් කරනව. 
 චිත්‍රපටය අවසන් වන නිහඬ දර්ශනයේ දී, මහලු නිවාසයේ තනි වූ ෆ්‍රෑන්ක් තම කාමරයේ දොර මඳක් ඇර යන ලෙස තමන්ට සෙත් පතන්නට ආ Father ට කියනවා. "දොර බාගෙට ඇරල තියල යන්ඩ" කියලා. මෙම Partially Opened Door (මඳක් විවෘත කළ දොර) කියන්නෙ සිනමාත්මකව බැලුවොත් මට හිතෙන විදිහට ඔහුගේ ජීවිතයේ ඉතිරි වූ එකම බලාපොරොත්තුව.  එනම්; තමන්ව සදහටම ප්‍රතික්ෂේප කළ තම ආදර දියණිය හරි, තමන් ඝාතනය කළ මිතුරා (ජීමි හොෆා) හරි ආපහු එයි කියල හිතන යටිසිතේ ඇති ආශාව (Subconscious Hope).  
ඒ වගේ ම කිසිදාක සමාවක් නොලැබෙන පැවැත්ම පිළිබඳ අතිශය ශෝකය( Existential Despair ) සංකේතවත් කරන අතිශය සංවේදී අවසානයක්.
මේ කොච්චර අපුරු සිනමා අවසානයක් ද කියනව නං ජාත්‍යන්තර  විචාරකයන් කියන විදිහට, මේ දොර බාගෙට ඇර යන ලෙස ඉල්ලීම කියන්නේ, ඔහුගේ යටිසිතේ පවතින දැඩි  අනාරක්ෂිතභාවය ( Insecurity) සහ බිය(fear) සංකේතවත් කරන එකක්. මුළු ජීවිත කාලය පුරාම මරණය සහ ප්‍රචණ්ඩත්වය වැපිරූ මේ මිනිහා, ජීවිතයේ අවසාන මොහොතේ බයවෙනවා, වහල දාපු දොරක් පිටිපස්සෙ තියන පාලු හුදකලාවට. ඒක ඔහු කළ අපරාධවලට සංකේතාත්මක වන්දියක් ද? ඒ වගේ ම මරණය අභියස දැනෙන අසරණකම මඟහරවා ගන්ඩ දරන මනෝවිද්‍යාත්මක ආත්මාරක්ෂක උපක්‍රමයක් ද (Psychological Defense Mechanism ) කියලත් මට හිතෙනවා.

චිත්‍රපටයකට අදාළ හැම element එකක් ම කොච්චර හොඳින් සළකා බලා නිර්මාණය කළත්, නිරවද්‍යතාවය කොච්චර තිබුණත්, එසේ නොවන රූ ගැන්මක හරි, රූප ඇමිණුමක හරි, රඟපෑමක හරි අව්‍යාජ බව(Authenticity) තාත්වික, යථාර්තවාදී  බව(realistic), අදාළ බව විතරක්   තියනව නං?..... 
ඒක චිත්‍රපටයට ඇතළත් කරන්ඩ දෙවරක් හිතන්ඩ ඕන නෑ කියන පාඩම කියාදුන් අමරණීය අධ්‍යක්ෂවරුන් අතර ඉහළින් ම ඉන්න Scorsese ට  සිනමාව හොයන අප වැන්නන්ගේ නොවක් ආචාරය පුද කළ යුතුයි.

# The Emotional Expression of the Poet of Cinema’s Underworld

## *The Irishman*

Martin Scorsese is often regarded as the psychological mirror of the underworld. Interestingly, some critics have also associated Scorsese with the epithet used to describe Jean-Pierre Melville: the poet of cinema’s underworld .

The purpose of this article is to explore several remarkable aspects of Scorsese’s *The Irishman* (2019), a film that sensitively captures the emotional depth hidden beneath the brutal events of the criminal underworld.

## Theme and Storyline

Among Martin Scorsese’s works, *The Irishman* is a film fundamentally concerned with loyalty versus betrayal. It explores the psychological conflict of a man torn between his allegiance to the criminal organisation that provided him with protection and his bond with one of his closest friends.

Time and regret form another central theme. Having spent his younger years pursuing power, money and violence, the protagonist ultimately finds himself alone in old age, confronting the consequences of his actions and the mistakes he can never undo.

Simply put, this is a tragic story about organised crime, political conspiracies and the devastating ways in which they can destroy a human life.

Frank Sheeran, a truck driver who learned to kill his adversaries with remarkable ease and tactical precision during the Second World War, eventually becomes a powerful mob enforcer and contract killer under the protection of Russell Bufalino, a prominent Mafia boss. Frank also becomes the trusted bodyguard and close friend of Jimmy Hoffa, one of America’s most influential labour union leaders.

However, as tensions escalate between Hoffa and the Mafia, Frank is confronted with a devastating assignment: he must kill his own closest friend.

After carrying out the murder, Frank—a man who has taken countless lives—begins to hear the voice of his own conscience.

## Creative Contributions

Directed by Martin Scorsese, *The Irishman* is based on Charles Brandt’s book *I Heard You Paint Houses*.

* **Screenplay:** Steven Zaillian
* **Cinematography:** Rodrigo Prieto
* **Editing:** Thelma Schoonmaker, one of the most distinguished film editors in world cinema

The principal roles are played by three legendary Hollywood veterans: Robert De Niro as Frank “The Irishman” Sheeran, Al Pacino as Jimmy Hoffa, and Joe Pesci as Russell Bufalino.

The result is a remarkable cinematic collaboration that brings together three of Hollywood’s most celebrated senior actors.

## Three and a Half Hours That Sparked Debate

With a running time of approximately three and a half hours, *The Irishman* ranks among the longer feature films of its kind. Its considerable length provoked considerable debate among critics. Many argued that its slow pace could make it difficult to sustain audience engagement. Some even suggested that it would have worked better as a Netflix miniseries.

The film reportedly had a production budget of approximately US$159 million, while its theatrical box-office earnings were only around US$1.5 million. However, Netflix gained considerable prestige by providing a platform for such an ambitious work. The film also attracted a substantial streaming audience, reportedly reaching 40 million viewers during its first 28 days, alongside the broader commercial benefits associated with its Netflix release.

In response to criticism, Scorsese offered a compelling argument for the importance of the cumulative effect (Cumulative Effect) of a film’s storytelling.

For the ending to resonate deeply with an audience, he argued, viewers need to experience the entire journey. The loneliness and sorrow conveyed during the film’s final twenty minutes acquire their full emotional force only when audiences have absorbed the preceding hours of events.

It is a powerful defence of cinematic storytelling that values emotional accumulation over mere narrative efficiency.

## An Emotional Moment That Overruled Continuity

There is one extraordinary moment in this film that deserves particular attention, especially from anyone seriously interested in cinema.

As mentioned earlier, after Frank kills his friend Hoffa, he receives a telephone call from Hoffa’s wife. The moment he answers, she identifies herself by name. On hearing her name, Frank—whose familiarity with killing has made it seem almost as ordinary as swatting a mosquito—suddenly becomes deeply emotional.

Yet we can clearly see that a jump cut has been inserted rather conspicuously into Frank’s close-up. This was a decision made by the world-renowned editor Thelma Schoonmaker in collaboration with the equally celebrated director Scorsese.

The choice provoked considerable discussion among critics and film enthusiasts. For some reason, the reaction to the telephone call had not been captured in a continuous take; instead, it had been filmed as a separate shot. Rather than allowing this technical discontinuity to compromise the moment, the editor and director chose to preserve the emotional truth of the performance, placing emotion above technical perfection.

Scorsese’s position can be understood in terms of two important principles: preserving performance and challenging the audience.

His reasoning, in essence, was this:

“I have to preserve De Niro’s mature, emotionally powerful performance here. I cannot destroy this extraordinary moment by compromising it for the sake of technical continuity. Even if we shoot it again, we may never recapture it. At the same time, we have to challenge the audience. I have no desire to spoon-feed viewers or simply make them swallow whatever is presented to them. I do not want to conceal the technical imperfection with visual effects or smooth out the edit at the expense of an outstanding performance. What matters to me here is the emotion.”

In my view, this is a historic statement and an exceptional creative decision.

It offers a valuable lesson to filmmakers who prioritise technical perfection above everything else. It is also an important example for television channels in Sri Lanka, as well as certain judging panels, where technical polish can sometimes be given greater importance than the authenticity of a performance.

## Bringing the Language of the Underworld to Life on Screen

Another memorable moment deserves attention.

It occurs when Jimmy Hoffa, played by Pacino, speaks to Frank over the telephone and says:

“I heard you paint houses.”

Frank Sheeran, played by De Niro, replies:

“Yes. Yes, sir, I... I do. And I also do my own carpentry.”

In the language of organised crime, these seemingly ordinary expressions carry sinister meanings.

* **“Paint houses”** refers to killing people with firearms, leaving the walls splattered with blood.
* **“Carpentry”** alludes to the disposal of bodies and the removal of evidence after a killing—in other words, making sure the bodies and the traces of the crime cannot be discovered.

Through this coded language, the screenwriter and director Scorsese reveal the chilling reality concealed beneath the seemingly innocuous words of the criminal underworld.

This is another distinctive achievement of the film: its ability to transform the brutal mechanics of organised crime into cinematic expression. The importance of its subtext —what the dialogue communicates beyond its literal meaning—should not be overlooked.

## The Solitary Trauma That Follows a Lifetime of Brutal Murders

More disturbing than the gunshots heard throughout the film is the existential despair and terminal solitude Frank Sheeran confronts at the end. These elements leave a profound emotional impact on the audience.

To me, this is not a heroic portrait of a ruthless criminal. It is the deeply tragic conclusion to the life of a man who has betrayed his own humanity and emotional bonds.

Among the many films that glorify mob bosses and contract killers who murder without hesitation, *The Irishman* stands apart. Its distinction lies in revealing a fundamental truth: even those who kill for a living are human beings, capable of feeling the weight of their actions, their losses and their loneliness.

## The Relentless Contract Killer Rejected by His Own Daughter

To put it briefly, Frank’s final scenes reveal a man who has spent his entire life killing people at the command of those above him, yet finds himself utterly powerless when confronted with the silent rejection of his own daughter.

The impact of Peggy’s silence is something Frank simply cannot bear. Her silence unsettles not only him but also the audience.

In the end, Frank goes to the bank where his daughter works, hoping to see her and apologise. What follows is extraordinary. Her response is silent and strangely devastating. She places a sign reading “Counter Closed” on her counter and quietly walks away.

Robert De Niro’s ability to convey Frank’s emotional state as he watches his daughter leave is a remarkable demonstration of subtle, emotionally nuanced acting.

His performance is extraordinarily restrained, yet it generates a palpable tension that reaches deep inside us. There is no need for an outburst, an explanation or an exaggerated gesture. The pain is already there, unmistakably present in his face.

## The Metaphor of the Partially Open Door

In the film’s final moments, the subtle changes in De Niro’s facial expressions (Micro-expressions), the suppressed agony in his eyes and his overwhelming sense of guilt create an experience that is both unsettling and deeply moving.

In the closing scene, Frank, now an old man living alone in a nursing home, asks the priest who has come to offer him spiritual comfort to leave his bedroom door slightly open.

“Leave the door half open,” he asks.

Viewed cinematically, the partially opened door  can be interpreted as the last remaining hope in Frank’s life.

Perhaps, somewhere in his subconscious, he still longs for his beloved daughter—who has effectively rejected him forever—or even for his murdered friend, Jimmy Hoffa, to return.

This is also an intensely moving ending that symbolises existential despair (Existential Despair): the anguish of a life in which forgiveness may never come.

The brilliance of this ending lies in the psychological possibilities suggested by that simple request. As some international critics have interpreted it, Frank’s desire to keep the door partially open symbolises his profound insecurity  and fear.

A man who has spent his entire life spreading death and violence is now frightened, in his final years, by the prospect of the desolate loneliness that lies behind a closed door.

Is this a symbolic punishment for the crimes he has committed? Or is it a psychological defence mechanism, an attempt to protect himself from the helplessness he feels when confronted with his own mortality?

To me, the scene allows for both interpretations. Its power lies precisely in its restraint and ambiguity.

## A Lasting Lesson in Cinematic Authenticity

No matter how carefully every element of a film is considered and crafted, and no matter how technically accurate the result may be, what ultimately matters is the authenticity, realism and relevance of a shot, an edit or a performance.

If a particular shot, edit or performance contains genuine authenticity, realism and relevance—even if it is not technically flawless—should we not think twice before deciding to exclude it from the film?

This is one of the enduring lessons taught by Scorsese, a director who deserves to be counted among the great masters of cinema.

For those of us who continue to explore, study and search for the deeper possibilities of filmmaking, he deserves our heartfelt respect.

---

*My appreciation for the significance of this film was renewed during an extended conversation with veteran film editor Ravindra Guruge, who drew my attention to its distinctive approach to editing. That conversation inspired me to revisit the film after several years and write down my reflections. I therefore wish to extend my heartfelt thanks to Ravi Ayya for sharing his valuable insights and inspiring this article.* 🙏

**— Suranga Lakmal Senevirathne**

sharedPost.text:
Chcesz zostać aktorką/aktorem albo mieć więcej aktorskiej pracy ale nie wiesz co konkretnie zrobić? 🤔 Jeżeli tak - zapraszam na konsultacje do mnie, nagranie wizytówek i montaż demo aktorskiego! 🎬🤩 Szczegóły w opisie! 

🎥 Mentoring aktorski 

Dla kogo? 

Dla każdego kto chce pracować jako aktor/aktorka na planach zdjęciowych. Zarówno dla tych bez doświadczenia, któryórzy nie wiedzą jak zacząć i co zrobić jak i dla tych co już pierwsze kroki mają za sobą ale chcieliby mieć więcej pracy i potrzebują rady w tym zakresie 🙂 

Na czym polega? 

Spotkanie ze mną 1:1 online, trwające godzinę. Opowiesz mi jakie zlecenia aktorskie Cię interesują - czyli Twój aktorski cel i według tego dobieramy odpowiedni plan działania. Jeżeli masz materiały aktorskie - to je omówimy i powiem co warto byłoby jeszcze do nich dodać lub jak je “podrasować”. Jeżeli nie masz to dowiesz się co i jak masz zrobić żeby je mieć 🙂 Powiem o moich poleceniach agencji aktorskich, jak samodzielnie i łatwo zrobić demo, jak nagrać i co powiedzieć w wizytówkach, jak samodzielnie szukać pracy, jak się wyceniać, na co uważać. I odpowiem na wszystkie inne Twoje pytania. Po spotkaniu otrzymasz ode mnie maila z planem działania i priorytetami do wykonania + materiałami pomocniczymi dot. materiałów aktorskich. 

🎥 Coaching aktorski z wizytówki + nagranie wizytówek w studio 

Na czym polega? 

✅ Tworzę tekst do wizytówek na podstawie informacji o Twoim doświadczeniu, pasjach, zainteresowaniach, który dostajesz przed nagraniem według castingowych wytycznych, który pokaże Twoje największe atuty

✅W studio nagrań nagrywamy 3-4 wizytówki:

🎬 do filmów i seriali 
🎬 do reklam w wersji dłuższej 
🎬 do reklam w wersji krótszej 
🎬 w języku obcym 
Ewentualnie możemy dograć wizytówkę modelingową 

✅ W trakcie nagrywania zadbam o Twoje rozluźnienie, dobrą atmosferę oraz zrobimy kilka ćwiczeń które pomogą pokazać na wizytówkach Twoją energię i błysk w oku 
oraz będę czuwać nad całym procesem

✅ Wizytówki nagramy według aktualnych standardów i wymogów castingowych 

✅ Dostaniesz zmontowane wizytówki gotowe do wysłania przez WeTransfer

🎥 Demo aktorskie 

montaż demo aktorskiego + konsultacja 

Na czym polega? 

✅ otrzymasz ode mnie demo aktorskie zmontowane zgodnie z obecnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu + podczas konsultacji wspólnie dobierzemy sceny, które się w nim znajdą oraz przedstawię Ci mój pomysł na ich kolejność 

Podczas konsultacji dowiesz się również:

✅ jak pobierać materiały do demo aktorskiego 
✅ jakie są obecne wymogi i standardy wzgledem aktorskiego demo 
✅ jakie sceny wybierać i w jakiej kolejności je zmontować  
✅ jak samemu w łatwy sposób przemontować demo pod konkretny casting 

Szczegóły priv

💥Poszukuję przyszłej mamy!💥
Na plan serialu w Łodzi do ujęć bliskich potrzebujemy Kobiety, która na dzień 30.10 będzie w ok 5mcu ciąży (ok 18-21 tydzień ciąży)

⏰Data planu: 30.10

⏰To będzie jedna scena, ale nie wiemy, w którym momencie dnia będzie realizowana więc zapraszam do zgłoszeń Panie, które cały ten dzień mają dyspozycyjny (godzinę i adres startu poznamy na dzień przed planem)

💶Stawka: 300zl (wypłata blik lub przelew od razu po planie)

Plus zwrot za dojazd do Łodzi 

📬☎️ Chętne Panie proszę o zgłoszenie na mail: Justyna.lapka@atlantafilms.pl 

W tytule: 30.10

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr tel, miejscowość, wiek ciąży na dzień zgłoszenia oraz zdjęcie brzuszka (może być bez twarzy mamy- sylwetka z brzuszkiem)

items.text:
‼️ Uwaga Górny ŚLĄSK ‼️
Serdecznie zapraszamy do udziału w nowym serialu Polsatu, pn. GLINIARZE ŚLĄSK. ☀️ Świetna zabawa i dobry czas na planie gwarantowany❗️

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📸 PILNE | ZDJĘCIE POTRZEBNE DZISIAJ 🎞️

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹GANGSTER 4 - mężczyzna (35–45 lat). Bandzior o ponurym wyglądzie.

Ważne: potrzebne jest wyłącznie zdjęcie, bez udziału w planie (!). Zdjęcie należy przesłać jak najszybciej.

💰 Wynagrodzenie: 150 zł netto.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 27 PAŹDZIERNIKA (WTOREK)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 KELNERKA - kobieta (25–30 lat). Sympatyczna dziewczyna pracująca w zajeździe. 2 sceny.

💰 300 zł netto

🔹 GANGSTER 3 - mężczyzna (35–45 lat). Typ bandziora o ponurym wyglądzie (1-2 sceny).

💰 300 zł netto

🔹 HAZARDZIŚCI - x3 mężczyzn (35–45 lat) (1-2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto/os.

🔹 POKERZYŚCI - x4 osoby (40–55 lat) (1-2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto/os.

🔹 BARMAN - mężczyzna (ok. 30 lat) (1-2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto

🔹 KRUPIER - mężczyzna (ok. 26 lat) (1-2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto

🔹 SANDRA - kobieta (około 22 lat). Atrakcyjna dziewczyna, córka Brokera, której życie kończy się tragicznie w wyniku uzależnienia od narkotyków i przebywania w niebezpiecznym środowisku (1 scena).

💰 200 zł netto

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 29 PAŹDZIERNIKA (CZWARTEK)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 KUMPEL 2 - mężczyzna (40–45 lat), pochodzenia ukraińskiego. Prosty, zwyczajny facet. Dąbrowa Górnicza, ok. 4 km od Pałacu Kultury Zagłębia (1 scena).

💰 300 zł netto

🔹 TRUP FACETA - mężczyzna (ok. 36 lat), krótkie włosy pod perukę. Ruda Śląska, dzielnica Zgoda (1 scena).

💰 200 zł netto

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 30 PAŹDZIERNIKA (PIĄTEK)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 KIEROWCA - mężczyzna (ok. 60 lat). Przypadkowy człowiek, który trafia w sam środek strzelaniny. Katowice, dzielnica Piotrowice (1 scena).

💰 300 zł netto

🔹 GOŚCIE W ZAJEŹDZIE - x5 osób, kobiety i mężczyźni (25–55 lat). Katowice, dzielnica Murcki. Plan późno-popołudniowy (po 16/17:00) (2 sceny).

💰 200 zł netto/os.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 31 PAŹDZIERNIKA (SOBOTA)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔹 ZATRZYMANY - mężczyzna (25–45 lat). Katowice, dzielnica Koszutka (1 scena).

💰 150 zł netto

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

💰 WYNAGRODZENIE:

Wszystkie stawki podane są w kwotach netto. Umowa o dzieło. Wypłata gotówką po planie.

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA wyślij na e-mail:

gliniarzeslask@gmail.com

📌 Tytuł zgłoszenia: „Nazwa roli | Data zdjęć”

W mailu podaj wszystkie poniższe dane, dokładnie wg. pniższej formatki ⬇️:

- imię i nazwisko

- telefon

- miejsce zamieszkania (kod pocztowy + miejscowość)

- data urodzenia

- wzrost (w cm) / waga (w kg)

- rozmiar obuwia (w numeracji EU)

📸 Dołącz 2 aktualne zdjęcia (w mailu jako załącznik): portret; sylwetka.

Zdjęcia możesz zrobić telefonem:

❌ bez innych osób w kadrze, bez okularów, bez nakrycia głowy.

—

⚠️ Skontaktujemy się z wybranymi osobami. Produkcja nie zwraca kosztów dojazdu ani zakwaterowania (!).

—

Do zobaczenia na planie❗️

123Cast | Casting. Ludzie. Film. 🪄🎬

—

𝙿𝚘𝚜𝚝 𝚗𝚊𝚙𝚒𝚜𝚊ł 𝚌𝚣ł𝚘𝚠𝚒𝚎𝚔, 𝚐𝚛𝚊𝚏𝚒𝚔ę 𝚜𝚝𝚠𝚘𝚛𝚣𝚢ł 🤖.

Wonderful actor, director, producer and coach, and my great friend and colleague, Buddy Brennan of Leprechaun Coaching in Cambridge say’s:  “If you are an actor you will benefit from Michael’s teaching. I have seen him work and I can honestly say • he truly knows how to work with actors - HE WILL MAKE YOU BETTER THAN YOU ARE NOW!”

Now is the perfect time to sign up for all or any of the 3 steps our comprehensive CERTIFICATE PROGRAM! 

STEP 1: PRIVATE COACHING - 

6x1hr sessions, learn or re-enforce the essentials, with trusted process preparation techniques and direction, we prepare and tape contrasting monologues. Add to your reel! $399 + tx.

STEP 2: SEMIPRIVATE, SCENE-STUDY - 

3x2hr sessions. I partner you, we review and apply the preparation techniques. We tape 2 scenes with playback, notes and direction, with a focus on on-camera technique - living in the scene! Add to your reel! $299 + tx.
 
Or .. alternate STEP 2: THURSDAY NIGHT SCENE-STUDY CLASS - 

In this Scene-study class, we’re preparing and taping scenes, telling compelling stories, applying process preparation techniques and analysis, with a focus on screen acting skills and technique, using 2 cameras. 

OCTOBER THURSDAY NIGHT SCENE-STUDY CLASS - SIGN UP NOW! 
Nov. 5,12,19,26. 6:30-9:30 pm. 
$299 + tx.

STEP 3: THE SUCCESSFUL AUDITIONS WORKSHOP - 2 days, sharpen your audition skills, plus SELF-TAPE AUDITIONS, for commercials and film and TV series, we tape your 2 auditions, with critique, coaching, direction and demonstration. Next: DEC. 12-13, repeats every 3rd mth. $199 + tx.

CERTIFICATE PROGRAM (ALL 3 STEPS) Comprehensive training! $899 + tx. (Discounted package price - take advantage!) 

All taped work is your’s, for your reel! Agent referrals! For more information, contact Michael:
416 294-3754 / bongoproductions.com.

sharedPost.text:
Szukamy naszej filmowej babci i przytulnego domu w Warszawie!

W Impact Warsaw przygotowujemy krótki, ciepły i zabawny film w klimacie polskich świąt Bożego Narodzenia.

Szukamy starszej pani, która chciałaby zagrać babcię. Doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest konieczne. Liczą się naturalność, serdeczność i poczucie humoru.

Do zdjęć szukamy również domu lub mieszkania z ciepłym, tradycyjnym wystrojem i dekoracjami świątecznymi. Można zgłosić się do roli lub zaproponować samo miejsce.

Może Wasza mama, babcia lub sąsiadka chciałaby spróbować? Albo znacie odpowiedni dom?

Napiszcie do mnie prywatnie, chętnie opowiem więcej!

We’re looking for our film grandma and a cosy home in Warsaw!

At Impact Warsaw, we’re making a short, warm and funny film celebrating Polish Christmas.

We’re looking for an older woman who would enjoy playing Grandma. Acting experience isn’t essential. Warmth, natural expressions and a sense of humour are what matter.

We’re also looking for a home we could borrow for filming, with traditional character, a warm, cosy interior and Christmas decorations. You can help with either the role or the location.

Perhaps your mum, grandma or neighbour would enjoy being involved? Or you know a suitable home?

Please send me a private message. I’d love to tell you more!

Male actors wanted for The Crucible this coming February. Rehearsals start November 1
Calling all mature male actors in Ottawa-Gatineau. 

Rehearsals will be Sundays 1-5 and Wednesdays 6-8:30 with a break from December 16 to January 6.

We're urgently looking for a few more male actors to fill supporting and smaller roles in our community theatre production of Arthur Miller's The Crucible. 

We're looking for enthusiastic performers who enjoy bringing interesting characters to life. 

We have a large group of actors already to go. We just want to fill in these parts strongly. 

Auditions, please reach out ASAP. 

We are holding callbacks tonight, Thursday, October twenty-second, and would welcome interested actors who are available to join us. 

Can't make it tonight? 

No problem. 

We're also accepting video auditions. Video audition deadline, Friday, October 30.

If you're interested, please send me a private message as soon as possible and I'll provide the details. 

Please share this post with anyone you think might be interested. Natalie Fraser, director, The Crucible.

Connect@nataliefraser.ca

My name is Delroy Goveas, I'm a writer-director. My girlfriend Gracie Henneberry is directing her first original short film for Digi60 Filmmakers' Festival titled Between us and the Lord (comedy/drama).  The film is about the passing of a loved one and the coping mechanisms adopted by that person's family. 

We're currently looking for extras dressed in black and white attire. There will be food provided. Filming is on at 8:00am to 4:00pm on the 31st of October, the very spooky halloween. If you're interested, fill out the form!

https://forms.gle/xUj4N945gbUDo5Jx5

Actors!!! For the first time since 2021 - I’m getting back into the acting class room with my company on Mondays to work with both aspiring and working actors in this 8-Week Acting for the Camera Lab at Heritage College. 7:30-10:30pm

We will be workshopping new material in development, practicing auditions on camera aka self-tape magic, filming and reviewing with constructive feedback, the business of acting from the audition all the way to the red carpet, the power of creating your own work, being your best and truest self, confident on camera and working with fear, joy, love, sadness, frustration - whatever the story and the character calls for. You will have a blast identifying the little tricks that make your acting go from fake and unmoving to stunning, real and captivating! Spaces are limited. Please dm for details and to reserve your spot. ✨🎬❤️😌🎥

#actingcoach #screentraining #claudiajurt #joshuaodjick #acting

Short on-camera demos and roleplay beats (stronger vs weaker delivery, auction-floor moments). Clear, grounded, easy to direct.

Shoot: November 9 and 10, 2026

Location: Metro Vancouver

To apply, email casting@your-story.agency with a headshot, a short reel or self-tape, and which role(s) you're applying for.

items.text:
🎬 RUHR TAKE – Wir drehen jeden Monat einen Film in 24 Stunden

Hey, kurze Frage in die Runde:

Ich stelle im Ruhrgebiet ein festes kreatives Team zusammen, mit dem wir einmal im Monat innerhalb von 24 Stunden einen kompletten Kurzfilm entwickeln und fertigstellen.

Morgens um 8 Uhr steht nur das Genre fest. Danach entstehen gemeinsam Idee, Drehbuch, Szenenplanung und Produktion – um Mitternacht ist der Film fertig geschnitten. Eine zweite Kamera begleitet den gesamten Prozess mit Behind-the-Scenes-Aufnahmen und Zeitraffern.

Die fertigen Filme und Einblicke in die Produktion veröffentlichen wir auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube. Auf Instagram sollen die Beiträge nach Möglichkeit als Collab-Posts mit den beteiligten Teammitgliedern erscheinen.

Gesucht werden Menschen für:

• Regie

• Kamera und BTS-Kamera

• Ton und Licht

• Schnitt und Postproduktion

• Social Media

• Schauspiel

Du musst kein Profi sein. Wichtiger sind Zuverlässigkeit, Lust aufs Filmemachen und die Bereitschaft, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Das Projekt ist aktuell unbezahlt. Dafür erhältst du verwendbares Material für dein Portfolio, Sichtbarkeit über gemeinsame Veröffentlichungen und Zugang zu einem Netzwerk, mit dem auch außerhalb des Formats weitere Projekte entstehen können.

Wenn du Interesse hast, schreib mir bitte kurz:

• welchen Bereich du übernehmen möchtest

• aus welcher Stadt du kommst

• wie deine ungefähre Verfügbarkeit aussieht

• gerne einen Link zu bisherigen Arbeiten – auch ohne Portfolio kannst du dich melden

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/keremdg_/

Das vollständige Konzept:

https://gamma.app/docs/RUHR-TAKE-Ein-Tag-Ein-Film-vatmb9rp27hgijl

Ich freue mich auf kreative Leute, die wirklich Lust haben, gemeinsam Filme zu machen.

# 🎬 CASTING & PRODUCTION CALL: “Dr. Jason III”

Early casting and pre-production are officially underway for **“Dr. Jason III,”** the highly anticipated sequel to the award-winning films *Dr. Jason* and *Dr. Jason II – Lights & Shadows*, streaming internationally on Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Tubi, Plex, Fawesome, and other platforms!

🎥 **Filming is scheduled for 2027 in the Stuttgart area of Germany.**
## 🎭 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are currently seeking:
* 🎬 **Actors & Actresses** — Paid opportunities
* ⭐ **Featured Extras** — Paid opportunities
* 📸 **Models** — Paid opportunities
* 🤝 **Early Contributors** — Exclusive perks and opportunities to receive Producer and Special Thanks credits

💡 **Interested in supporting the production?** An official Indiegogo campaign with exclusive perks is coming soon!

📩 **HOW TO APPLY**

Interested in joining the cast, participating in the production, or learning more about early contribution opportunities?

**Please send a private message (PM) to apply or request further information.**

* **IMDb:** [https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32550434](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt32550434)

* **Rotten Tomatoes:** Coming soon
* **FilmFreeway:** Coming soon
* **Indiegogo:** Coming soon
## 🎬 ABOUT GEORGE TOUNAS

Learn more about filmmaker and actor George Tounas through his official profiles and film industry platforms:
* **IMDb:** [https://www.imdb.com/name/nm2466502](https://www.imdb.com/name/nm2466502)

Szukamy naszej filmowej babci i przytulnego domu w Warszawie!

W Impact Warsaw przygotowujemy krótki, ciepły i zabawny film w klimacie polskich świąt Bożego Narodzenia.

Szukamy starszej pani, która chciałaby zagrać babcię. Doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest konieczne. Liczą się naturalność, serdeczność i poczucie humoru.

Do zdjęć szukamy również domu lub mieszkania z ciepłym, tradycyjnym wystrojem i dekoracjami świątecznymi. Można zgłosić się do roli lub zaproponować samo miejsce.

Może Wasza mama, babcia lub sąsiadka chciałaby spróbować? Albo znacie odpowiedni dom?

Napiszcie do mnie prywatnie, chętnie opowiem więcej!

We’re looking for our film grandma and a cosy home in Warsaw!

At Impact Warsaw, we’re making a short, warm and funny film celebrating Polish Christmas.

We’re looking for an older woman who would enjoy playing Grandma. Acting experience isn’t essential. Warmth, natural expressions and a sense of humour are what matter.

We’re also looking for a home we could borrow for filming, with traditional character, a warm, cosy interior and Christmas decorations. You can help with either the role or the location.

Perhaps your mum, grandma or neighbour would enjoy being involved? Or you know a suitable home?

Please send me a private message. I’d love to tell you more!

🎬 CASTING CALL 🎬
💥 DECEMBER 28, 1835: THE AMBUSH THAT CHANGED FLORIDA FOREVER – CASTING NOW!

​Are you ready to step back in time and bring history to life on the silver screen?

​3 Rats Entertainment is officially casting non-union Actors & Background players for DEFIANCE , a major, ground-breaking historical feature film telling the untold story of Major Francis L. Dade’s command and the powder keg that ignited the Second Seminole War.

​⚠️ WHY THIS STORY MATTERS:

On December 28, 1835, 108 U.S. soldiers marched into the dark Florida pine woods, unaware they were stepping into one of the most ruthless, devastating, and horrifying ambushes in American military history. Trapped in a brutal, desperate fight for survival, nearly the entire command was wiped out in a single morning. 

This isn’t just history, it is a harrowing, raw, and pulse-pounding saga of conflict, courage, and tragedy that changed Florida forever.

​This is Florida’s biggest epic history film, bringing an unforgettable, unvarnished, and deeply important story to the screen for the very first time!

items.text:
Title: Actors, what’s your biggest frustration with pursuing acting?
Hey everyone!

I’m an aspiring actor exploring ways to create helpful resources for fellow performers, but I want to understand the challenges many of my fellow actors actually face first.

Whether it’s auditions, self-tapes, finding opportunities, preparing roles, or something else entirely, what’s one recurring problem you wish had a better solution?

Not selling anything—just genuinely interested in hearing your experiences and learning from other actors.

Thanks in advance!

topComments.text: That everyone gives more opportunity to the people they know or can be better marketing for their films, instead to real good talents"""

Hey everyone!

I’m an aspiring actor exploring ways to create helpful resources for fellow performers, but I want to understand the challenges many of my fellow actors actually face first.

Whether it’s auditions, self-tapes, finding opportunities, preparing roles, or something else entirely, what’s one recurring problem you wish had a better solution?

Not selling anything—just genuinely interested in hearing your experiences and learning from other actors.

Thanks in advance!

Approximately 1 month

🎬 **PAID CASTING CALL | DENVER, CO**

We're looking for **two adults (ages 50–70)** to portray a married couple in a professional video production for a Denver-based remodeling and construction company.

The video will follow a realistic home remodeling journey, from the initial consultation through design and construction.

**Details:**
* 💰 Pay: $30/hour per person
* 📍 Location: Denver metro area (2 filming locations per day)
* 📅 2–3 filming days (dates TBD)
* 🎥 Simple, natural scenes with little to no dialogue
* No professional acting experience required
* Real couples are encouraged to apply!

We're looking for people who are natural, relatable, comfortable on camera, and reliable enough to commit to all scheduled filming days.

**📋 Interested? Apply here:**

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfu2BlwaqINBXdGO8ax86cP0tpswj2flhGP1KloPHXD88E07w/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108411361066735844477](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfu2BlwaqINBXdGO8ax86cP0tpswj2flhGP1KloPHXD88E07w/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108411361066735844477)

Please complete the application form to be considered. Selected applicants will be contacted with further details.

Feel free to share or tag someone who might be a great fit!

⭐️ CASTING CALL ⭐️
I’m excited to announce a casting call for our upcoming short film THE DAME, a  3rd year UWE student film set in Birmingham’s drag scene, exploring themes of ageing, identity, and what it means to be overlooked as the world moves on.
We are looking for three actors to bring our characters to life:
* The Dame (playing age 40+): An ageing drag performer with a strong stage presence, sharp comic timing and vulnerability beneath a confident persona.
* Teen (any gender, playing age 16–19): A curious teenager who forms an unexpected bond with an older drag performer, discovering a mutual understanding through their encounter.
* Talent Booker (Male, playing age 20–30): A sharp, professional character who prioritises popularity and audience numbers, with a confident delivery and dismissive edge. (Smaller role)
Requirements:
* Availability for filming in BRISTOL, one-day shoot 9th-13th NOV, final date TBD
* Preferably Bristol based
* Actors and drag performers welcome, but no formal experience required
* 
* This is a voluntary based role! However, food and transport will be provided.
If you’re interested in being part of the project, please send a headshot / a short introduction / any relevant showreel or previous work via DM or email.
We’d love to hear from you and bring THE DAME to life! 🎬
Please share around if you know anyone who would be a good fit!

Sound Recordist Call
We’re looking for a reliable and attentive Sound Recordist to join the crew of an upcoming short film.

Responsibilities:

▪️Constantly monitor audio levels and sound quality during filming.

▪️Monitor audio from microphones throughout each take.

▪️Ensure clear dialogue recording and identify any unwanted noise, interference, clipping, or dropouts.

▪️Check audio recordings and equipment to ensure everything is working properly.

▪️Communicate with the director and camera team to maintain good sound quality on set.

Please contact us: cinedanny88@gmail.com

Viele Grüße, euer Harlekin Filme Team

# **Casting Call **

Nous recherchons le rôle principal d’un court métrage produit par DMC production 

Un garçon d’origine africaine de 10- 12 ans.

Tournage prévue aux vacances scolaire de février 

Rémunération 500€ pour 6 jours de tournages 

Pas d’expérience de tournage requise mais un enfant dynamique et débrouillard 

A noté qu’il est indispensable d’être en situation régulière (titre de séjour valable)

Merci d’envoyer votre candidature par mail : 

castingteschaussures@gmail.com ou au 0652398405

Avec les infos suivantes : 

Nom / Prénom / Téléphone

Photo récente (portrait et en pied)

Âge et taille 

Pays d’origine et langues parlés ( si plusieurs) 

Merci

🎭 CASTING TEATRALE A ROMA – “NAPULE È”

L’APS “I viandanti sul mare” cerca attori e attrici per il nuovo spettacolo “Napule è”, una commedia brillante.

Ruoli ricercati:

• Michele – età scenica 30–40 anni; rappresentante della piccola borghesia, burbero e tendente alla pigrizia. È richiesto l’accento napoletano.
• Assuntina – età scenica 25–40 anni; svampita, ma dal carattere forte e ribelle. È richiesto l’accento napoletano.
• Antonio – età scenica 30–40 anni; vigliacco e a tratti ossessivo. È richiesto l’accento milanese.
• Saro – età scenica 30–40 anni; mitomane e tendente alla megalomania. È richiesto l’accento napoletano.
• Biagio – età scenica non definita; il classico portiere napoletano.
• Ciro – età scenica non definita; caratterialmente polemico. È richiesto l’accento napoletano.

📍 Le prove si svolgeranno a Roma per un periodo complessivo di 15 giorni tra il 15 febbraio e il 25 marzo 2027. Le date precise saranno comunicate dopo la selezione. Le prove non sono retribuite e non è previsto il rimborso delle spese.

💶 Compenso: 80 € a replica.

La prima replica è prevista il 3 aprile 2027 al Teatro Studio 8 di Nettuno. Sono previste ulteriori date tra luglio e agosto 2027 a Gaeta e Itri, oltre a repliche nella stagione teatrale 2027/2028.

Per la prima selezione, inviare CV e video con un monologo brillante entro il 10 dicembre 2026 a napulest@gmail.com.
Il monologo dovrà essere in napoletano, tranne per il ruolo di Antonio, per il quale è richiesto l’accento milanese.

Nell’oggetto dell’e-mail indicare il ruolo per cui ci si candida.

🎬 **PAID CASTING CALL: Two leads for a narrative spec commercial (London, 14–15 Nov)**

**(repost now with day rates set)**

We're PickledFish, an emerging Edinburgh-based narrative production company. We're casting two leads for a stylised, Matrix-inspired narrative spec commercial. It's a self-funded spec project. It's fully practical, shot on the Alexa Mini LF in a professional London studio (Zone 2) with a full professional crew.

See our work: https://pickledfish.tv

After a big night out, Leo collapses on his couch and wakes in an endless white room. A mysterious suited figure offers him a choice: painkillers and a wasted day, or something better.

📅 Shoot: 14–15 Nov, London

—

LEO (lead, male, playing age 21–35)

💷 £50/day · 2 shoot days

Leo is a committed raver: still dancing when he's running on empty, then waking up bright, sharp and himself again. The role has no dialogue, so it's all physicality and expression. It goes from exhausted and spaced-out, to confused and wide-eyed in the white room, to warm, easy and laughing the next morning.

We're looking for someone who:

- is comfortable dancing on camera

- can tell a story with their body and face, without lines

- is available both days

—

SUITED FIGURE (lead, any gender, any ethnicity, playing age 30–65)

💷 £85/day · 1 shoot day

The Suited Figure is a calm, commanding and slightly unnerving guide who exists in "the moment just before you fall asleep." Think of a hypnotic mentor figure: measured, precise, a little theatrical, with total control of the room. They wear a dark suit, green tie and rimless glasses, which we provide. A homage to a certain iconic character.

We're looking for someone with:

- a strong voice and mesmerising delivery, since this role carries all of the dialogue

- stillness and presence on screen

- availability for one day, within 14–15 Nov (we'll confirm the date once you're cast)

—

💷 Paid day rates as above, plus food on set, travel covered, an IMDb-style credit and a high-quality copy of the finished film for your reel.

Usage: this is a spec commercial. It'll be used on PickledFish's portfolio, online channels and in festival submissions.

—

🎥 HOW TO APPLY

Email your self-tape link, headshot and CV to hello@pickledfish.tv with the role name in the subject line, by Wed 28 Oct. Applications by email only, please. We can't take submissions via DM or comments.

LEO: walk to a chair, slump into it exhausted and fall asleep. Then wake up, open your hand, and smile at what you find. A 10–20 second dance clip is a bonus.

SUITED FIGURE: record a self-tape of these sides:

"This... is the moment just before you fall asleep. You have a choice to make. Maybe your head hurts a little bit less, but you still wake up sluggish and dazed, stuck in bed as the day marches on. Remember, the choice is yours, yours, yours, yours, yours, yours..."

Thank you!

URGENT CASTING CALL for Production 2 of The Black Widows Pilot
3-day film shoot on the 15th-17th November 2026 in Coventry/Rugby

We have a micro budget so will provide lunch and cover travel expenses

 

Our current cast includes makeup-artists, director of photography, 1st assistant director and script supervisor alongside our cast of actors and actresses.

 

We have the main cast recruited but have some additional exciting roles available

 

We are searching for some talented actresses and actors to bring some of these compelling characters to life on our BLACK WIDOWS production. 

Set against a decade of betrayal, ambition, and bloody survival, Black Widows follows a fierce all-female crew operating in the shadows of a massive criminal empire.

The Character Profiles are below;

1. CEE (Late Teens/ Early Twenties) (2 scenes (1 day) This is an LGBT role

* Ethnicity & Look: Mixed Race, Latino or ethnically ambiguous 

* The Character: A gifted athlete and musician who plays Toya’s love interest. Cee possesses strong morals, fierce internal strength, and a rare, unyielding conscience forged by her unique background and upbringing. 

* Vibe: Captivating, athletic, soulful, and morally grounded amidst the chaos.

2. KIDADA’S FRIEND ALYSSA (Age Flexible / Adult) (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Slender White female with curly hair.

* The Character: A gritty, street-level drug addict who features briefly in the storyline. Desperate and unpredictable, she ultimately squats in Kidada’s home while Kidada is away in rehab. 

* Vibe: Raw, vulnerable, authentic, and emotionally charged.

3. VIVIAN (One scene – Half a day)

* Demographic: Black or Mixed-Race Woman, 50s to Early 60s.

* The Role: Vivian is a hardened, razor-sharp, and deeply complex woman. A recovering alcoholic, she holds the heaviest title in the room: she is the mother of Brenda James, the notorious, ruthless "mother of the underworld." 

* The Vibe: Vivian is hateful, resentful, brilliant, and fiercely intelligent. She is a multi-layered powerhouse who commands every single scene she is in. If you love playing complex, unapologetic characters with dark depths and sharp edges, Vivian is the role for you.

4. BEN (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 30s Male.

* The Character: A low level street runner who is a known criminal

5. MARCUS (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 40s-50s Male.

* The Character: A local unstable sleazeball who hustles and does whatever it takes to get on in life

6. Claire (One scene 2-3 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race (Age flexible female)

* The Character: A kind and friendly support worker who works at the drug and substance misuse clinic

EXTRA’s roles are available in addition to the above roles 

BENEFITS OF BEING PART OF THE PRODUCTION

* Official IMDb Credit: Boost your industry profile with a major television credit.

* CV & Acting Portfolio Development: Work alongside top-tier talent and crew, capturing stellar footage and high-end broadcast-quality material for your showreel post the production’s release.

* This production comes with a potential opportunity to reprise your role in a massive, upcoming 14-part TV series extension subject to investment funding! 

Please DM me for further details and to apply for the roles.

Set against a decade of betrayal, ambition, and bloody survival, Black Widows follows a fierce all-female crew operating in the shadows of a massive criminal empire.

The Character Profiles are below;

1. CEE (Late Teens/ Early Twenties) (2 scenes (1 day) This is an LGBT role

* Ethnicity & Look: Mixed Race, Latino or ethnically ambiguous 

* The Character: A gifted athlete and musician who plays Toya’s love interest. Cee possesses strong morals, fierce internal strength, and a rare, unyielding conscience forged by her unique background and upbringing. 

* Vibe: Captivating, athletic, soulful, and morally grounded amidst the chaos.

2. KIDADA’S FRIEND ALYSSA (Age Flexible / Adult) (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Slender White female with curly hair.

* The Character: A gritty, street-level drug addict who features briefly in the storyline. Desperate and unpredictable, she ultimately squats in Kidada’s home while Kidada is away in rehab. 

* Vibe: Raw, vulnerable, authentic, and emotionally charged.

3. VIVIAN (One scene – Half a day)

* Demographic: Black or Mixed-Race Woman, 50s to Early 60s.

* The Role: Vivian is a hardened, razor-sharp, and deeply complex woman. A recovering alcoholic, she holds the heaviest title in the room: she is the mother of Brenda James, the notorious, ruthless "mother of the underworld." 

* The Vibe: Vivian is hateful, resentful, brilliant, and fiercely intelligent. She is a multi-layered powerhouse who commands every single scene she is in. If you love playing complex, unapologetic characters with dark depths and sharp edges, Vivian is the role for you.

4. BEN (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 30s Male.

* The Character: A low level street runner who is a known criminal

5. MARCUS (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 40s-50s Male.

* The Character: A local unstable sleazeball who hustles and does whatever it takes to get on in life

6. Claire (One scene 2-3 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race (Age flexible female)

* The Character: A kind and friendly support worker who works at the drug and substance misuse clinic

EXTRA’s roles are available in addition to the above roles 

BENEFITS OF BEING PART OF THE PRODUCTION

* Official IMDb Credit: Boost your industry profile with a major television credit.

* CV & Acting Portfolio Development: Work alongside top-tier talent and crew, capturing stellar footage and high-end broadcast-quality material for your showreel post the production’s release.

* This production comes with a potential opportunity to reprise your role in a massive, upcoming 14-part TV series extension subject to investment funding! 

Please DM me for further details and to apply for the roles.
