🎬 A busy and rewarding time on screen and in theatre!
Looking back, I’ve had some fantastic opportunities—from portraying Dr. Langford in the independent feature film The Hunt for Michael Myers (and reprising the role in its sequel, The Death of Michael Myers), to playing the General in a First World War drama for a BAFTA-winning director. 

Alongside my screen roles, I’ve stayed deeply active on stage, including productions such as Under the Mersey Moon, Julia's Song, On the Banks of the Royal Blue Mersey, and pantomime as the Wolf in Red Riding Hood.

I truly love bringing high-status, authoritative characters to life on stage and screen—whether it's playing MPs, lawyers, doctors, politicians, or detectives.

• Showreel: http://youtu.be/eznjevITvPA?si=Z31LxEZ3DFNJeaYl

🎄 POSZUKUJEMY MODELI I MODELEK DO ŚWIĄTECZNEJ SESJI ZDJĘCIOWEJ! 📸

Do realizacji klimatycznej, świątecznej sesji zdjęciowej poszukujemy osób (najchętniej rodzinki), które chciałyby stanąć przed obiektywem i wspólnie z nami stworzyć trochę świątecznej magii! ✨

🎁 Sesja realizowana jest na zasadzie barteru, czyli w zamian za udział otrzymacie profesjonalne zdjęcia, które będziecie mogli wykorzystać we własnym portfolio lub po prostu zachować na pamiątkę, do prywatnego czy rodzinnego albumu. ❤️

📍 Miejsce: Warszawa centrum 

📅 Termin: jutro, sobota, 24 października 2026 r.

🕚 Godzina: 11:00

Nie wymagamy profesjonalnego doświadczenia przed obiektywem. Zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności, swobodzie i dobrej energii!

📩 Jak się zgłosić?

Wyślijcie na adres: Mao16@vp.pl 

•⁠  ⁠kilka aktualnych zdjęć (nie muszą być profesjonalne),

•⁠  ⁠⁠imię,

Zgłaszajcie się jeśli jesteście dyspozycyjni w wybranym terminie ( 24.10.2026 godz. 11:00).

W tytule wiadomości wpiszcie: SESJA ŚWIĄTECZNA 2026.

Zastrzegamy sobie prawo do selekcji zgłoszeń. Odezwiemy się tylko do wybranych osób.

Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Been talking to some awesome people about a few roles in this show from my recent posts, and will be making final decisions fairly soon here! If you're interested in auditioning, or hearing more about any of the main or supporting roles, feel free to shoot us an email - thanks, all! 

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

**CASTING CALL: AUDITIONS OPEN** 

**Project Title:** ***The Life That I Want ***

**Shoot Dates:** Early December

**Rehearsals:** 2–3 days in late November

**Produced by: **Dimas Films 

**Location:** Denver, CO 

**Non-Union / Unpaid (Copy, Credit, and Meals Provided)**
**ABOUT THE PROJECT**

Leaving his home country to chase his Hollywood dream, Javier is paralyzed by a stage fright that keeps him trapped behind self-imposed walls. When an unexpected opportunity forces him into the spotlight, his journey intersects with Hayley, Kerlen, and Rumie—others facing their own internal barriers. Bound by a shared passion and a powerful musical centerpiece, they unite through movement and song to shatter their fears and embrace the true heart of their craft.

*Note: This is a dance- and movement-focused short film. All musical numbers will be ****lip-synced****—no live vocal performance or singing required!*
**CHARACTER BREAKDOWNS**
**1. HAYLEY**
* **Gender/Age:** Female, 18–25 (Any Ethnicity)
* **Description:** Expressive, intensely passionate, yet guarded. Hayley carries her own deep-seated internal barriers that hold her back from unleashing her full potential. She needs strong emotional depth and dynamic dance ability to convey her character's internal journey through movement.
**2. KERLEN**
* **Gender/Age:** Any Gender, 40+ (Any Ethnicity)

items.text:
Hello all! Happy spooky season. We at Birnamwood Productions are filming a fun, short music video on the weekend of November 7 + 8, looking for cast and crew who want to use their Halloween costumes just a little bit longer. Using the song F.a.S.T by local artist Seattle Kaye, we’re aiming for a Thriller-esque short of an oblivious pizza guy who delivers to a haunted house, puts on his headphones, and then dances unwittingly through a bunch of monsters trying to eat him. 

The location is in the Calhan area, and it will be an overnight shoot.

**Title:** Special Delivery

**Logline:** An oblivious pizza driver delivers a pizza in an obviously haunted house.

**Length:** 2-3 minutes, should be done in a single shoot day.

We’re looking for actors and costumes that lean toward biohazard, zombie, or alien aesthetics. We will have a stunt coordinator on site, so if you haven’t ever worked stunts before, this is a great time to learn. 

We are also casting one person for Oblivious Pizza Guy to dance through the haunted house ― if auditioning for that role, please include a clip of yourself dancing to F.a.S.T by Seattle Kaye.

We are also on the hunt for an ART DIRECTOR, so if you’re available, have experience with horror, and want to go all out for a silly horror comedy, be sure to let us know!

Casting Call link: 

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfF8C584mNbWj05bAOH4H0H3y6Yiv7FXlyGkVRceQvUOHW6Sg/viewform?usp=publish-editor](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfF8C584mNbWj05bAOH4H0H3y6Yiv7FXlyGkVRceQvUOHW6Sg/viewform?usp=publish-editor)

Hope to hear from you soon!

Actors: Could I get feedback on a free audition-preparation sample?
Hi everyone! I’m developing a personalized audition-preparation resource for beginner and early-career actors.

I’ve created a free three-page sample featuring character-discovery exercises, a rehearsal roadmap, and an audition checklist.

I’m looking for five adult actors, ideally with an upcoming audition, who would be willing to look through it and share their thoughts.

I’m especially interested in what you’d actually use, what feels unnecessary, and whether something like this would make your audition preparation easier.

This is early product research, not a sales pitch. If you’re interested, feel free to comment and I’ll share the sample. Thanks!

topComments.text: Nice one Daniel 👍 I am a 45 yr actor, director, and co-producer. I would like to see it ( steps, etc. ) I just had a huge audition.  The problem with it was, it was world wide so obviously greater competition.  I'll friend you if i can and stay in touch,  K ? TX ~ Mark 😉

🎬 THE MINER'S SON — HAVE YOU SEEN IT YET?

Set against the backdrop of the 1984 miners' strike, The Miner's Son is a story of family, music, ambition and the struggles of a community fighting for its future.

Inspired by the history of the Kent coalfields, this independent British feature film was made with passion, determination and a love of storytelling.

If you haven't seen it yet, why not give it a watch?

And if you have, we'd love to know what you thought!

🎥 Available on streaming platforms, including Amazon Prime Video. Tubi

Please share and help us keep independent British filmmaking alive! ❤️

#TheMinersSon #BritishIndependentFilm #KentCoalfields #MinersStrike #EtteconProductions

🎥 Montaż demo aktorskiego z konsultacją 

Potrzebujesz demo aktorskiego, które pokaże Twój talent aktorski i wszechstronność a jednocześnie będzie zgodne z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu? Chcesz dowiedzieć się jak pobierać materiały i jak tworzyć takie demo samemu w przyszłości w łatwy sposób oraz jak zwiększyć swoje szanse na konkretną role? Jeżeli tak to zapraszam do skorzystania z mojej usługi 🙂 

✅ dokładnie przejrzę Twoje aktorskie materiały, wybiorę najlepsze aktorsko sceny oraz różnorodne pod względem emocji i ról

✅ zmontuję demo zgodnie z aktualnymi wymogami reżyserów castingu uwzględniając również to, które sceny Ty uważasz za najlepsze 

✅ podczas konsultacji opowiem Ci o obecnych standardach montażu i doboru scen, dam dużo cennych rad abyś mogła / mógł w przyszłości montować demo samodzielnie 

✅ gotowe demo dostaniesz ode mnie maksymalnie w 2 dni od wysłania mi swoich materiałów

✅ przystępna cena 💵 szczegóły na priv 

Na zdjęciach załączam jedną z wiadomość od klienta po moim montażu 🔥💪 

Uwaga! Nie zajmuję się pobieraniem materiałów.

Hello All - My name is Shweta Walia and I am a Co-Producer of an upcoming South Asian Film called "The Ideal". The Ideal is being shot in multiple locations (Reston, Herndon, Ashburn) in Northern Virginia from Thursday, Nov 12th to Sunday Nov15th. We're looking for some Extras to be featured in this short film! Our team is looking for those who are curious about being in a professional film set and can wear traditional South Asian attire on set. It will only take a few hours. Food is provided. If interested, please email treelineproductions1204@gmail.com with the email subject: Interest as [ROLE] Extra - NAME, or DM us @treelineproductions!

Please see flyer for Role details, date and location of shooting.

**About the Film**

The Ideal is a short family drama about two South Asian American brothers who reunite

following the death of their mother. One brother left home to pursue professional success, while

the other stayed behind and became their mother's primary caregiver. Over the course of their

reunion, years of unspoken resentment surrounding family, sacrifice, and success begin to

surface.

The Ideal is a short family drama about two South Asian American brothers who reunite

following the death of their mother. One brother left home to pursue professional success, while

the other stayed behind and became their mother's primary caregiver. Over the course of their

reunion, years of unspoken resentment surrounding family, sacrifice, and success begin to

surface.

# LGBTQ+ SUPPORTERS AND ADVOCATES 
LA BASED 

Right now, we are in pre-production on an intentional dating series called *The Booquet*, running alongside our podcast *3 Letters Deep*. Mainstream media consistently leaves Black, trans, and queer folks out of genuine romance or reduces us to a punchline, so we are producing the real thing ourselves.

We are locking in two specific lanes:
1. Singles who want actual connection. If you are Black, LGBTQ+ (specifically centering trans men and women), and done with the games on dating apps, pull up. We are actively casting intentional people ready for a real dynamic.
2. Filmmakers, editors, and crew. We are actively bringing on collaborators who care about raw, grounded storytelling and want to work on independent productions that center our people.

If you are single and looking, or if you do production work and want to link up on this shoot, drop a comment or hit my DMs directly. If you know someone who fits either lane, tag them below.

Let's talk!

Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Hey everyone! 🎬

Just finished filming my first short film (launching in November!) and I’m officially pivoting into proper acting after years of doing UGC and content creation.

I’m London-based, fluent in Portuguese, and have a native NYC accent (lived in New York for 7 years). I'm starting acting classes soon and looking to jump into extra work, cameos, and roles of any size to learn and hone my craft.

If you’re casting or working on something in London, let’s connect!

👑✨ PRINCESS LIVE! CASTING CALL ✨👑
Darling Productions UK are now casting talented female identifying triple threat professional performers for our brand new 2027 UK tour of Princess Live! 💖👸🏼

We’re looking for talented, friendly and engaging performers who can bring our iconic princesses to life in this magical, all singing, all dancing fairytale adventure! ✨🎶

📅 TOUR DATES:

• 1st – 21st February 2027

• 26th March – 11th April 2027

• 28th May – 6th June 2027

• 24th – 31st October 2027

🔔 Please note this is a split contract, with gaps between tour dates. Performers must be available for all dates listed, as well as rehearsals.

To apply, please submit:

• A recent headshot

• Vocal reel

• Your current location/base

📩 Please send all submissions to casting@darlingproductions.co.uk

🎬 The next stage of the casting process will be a self-tape audition.

⏰ APPLICATION DEADLINE: 1ST NOVEMBER 2026

🚫 Please only apply if you can commit to all the dates listed.

🚗 Travel and accommodation is provided while on tour.

We can’t wait to see your submissions and find the talented performers who will bring our magical princesses to life in 2027! 👑✨💖

#PrincessLive #CastingCall #TheatreCasting #DarlingProductionsUK #UKTour2027

🎭 CASTING TEATRALE A ROMA – “NAPULE È”

L’APS “I viandanti sul mare” cerca attori e attrici per il nuovo spettacolo “Napule è”, una commedia brillante.

Ruoli ricercati:

• Michele – età scenica 30–40 anni; rappresentante della piccola borghesia, burbero e tendente alla pigrizia. È richiesto l’accento napoletano.
• Assuntina – età scenica 25–40 anni; svampita, ma dal carattere forte e ribelle. È richiesto l’accento napoletano.
• Antonio – età scenica 30–40 anni; vigliacco e a tratti ossessivo. È richiesto l’accento milanese.
• Saro – età scenica 30–40 anni; mitomane e tendente alla megalomania. È richiesto l’accento napoletano.
• Biagio – età scenica non definita; il classico portiere napoletano.
• Ciro – età scenica non definita; caratterialmente polemico. È richiesto l’accento napoletano.

📍 Le prove si svolgeranno a Roma per un periodo complessivo di 15 giorni tra il 15 febbraio e il 25 marzo 2027. Le date precise saranno comunicate dopo la selezione. Le prove non sono retribuite e non è previsto il rimborso delle spese.

💶 Compenso: 80 € a replica.

La prima replica è prevista il 3 aprile 2027 al Teatro Studio 8 di Nettuno. Sono previste ulteriori date tra luglio e agosto 2027 a Gaeta e Itri, oltre a repliche nella stagione teatrale 2027/2028.

Per la prima selezione, inviare CV e video con un monologo brillante entro il 10 dicembre 2026 a napulest@gmail.com.
Il monologo dovrà essere in napoletano, tranne per il ruolo di Antonio, per il quale è richiesto l’accento milanese.

Nell’oggetto dell’e-mail indicare il ruolo per cui ci si candida.

“Can’t Take You Anywhere” Student Short Comedy Film
When an entitled teenager attends a private business event with his parents, he fails to suppress his awkward and immature nature.

Looking for ￼3 actors for a 5 minute comedy! 

Roles are not paid or promised.

JOHN: Supporting role of the frat-like CEO who helps Thomas (the teenager) make a terrible first impression with a girl seemingly his age. John is overconfident, loud, and raunchy. Looking for a male actor around his 40s.

MOM: Regular mom, mid 40s, who believed her son wouldn’t make a scene and is a supportive as possible for her husband and son.

DAD: Regular dad, also mid 40s, who knew that bringing Thomas was a bad idea. Dad’s goal is to secure a deal with John, the CEO.

We are also looking for plenty of extras for the business party scene.

We will be shooting around the first three weekends of November￼ around Denver, and are fairly flexible as it should be only 1-2 sets. If you are interested or have any questions, you can reach out to me at guinnico@gmail.com or 720-255-2717!

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗱𝗼 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻 𝗶𝗻 𝟱 𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗵𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗺𝘆 & 𝗪𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗠𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴?
​
You start with the foundations: anatomy, ergonomics, body mechanics, and how to use your own body well while working — essential for a long and sustainable career in massage.
​
Then the practical work builds month by month, from your first 30-minute sequence to a complete 90-minute massage.
​
The aim is not simply to memorise a sequence, but to understand what you’re doing well enough that the movements become familiar, precise, and adaptable to different bodies.
​
𝗝𝗼𝗶𝗻 𝘂𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗻𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴.
Starts January 23, 2027.
Only 4 places available.
​

items.text:
CASTING LONG MÉTRAGE – « UNE FLEUR SANS NOM » – Inspiré d'une histoire vraie – Région parisienne

Il lui a envoyé des roses. Sans carte. Sans nom.
Il savait parler devant des salles entières, mais pas dire trois mots à une seule personne.

« Une fleur sans nom » est un long métrage indépendant d'environ 95 minutes, adapté du livre du même nom et inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Une histoire d'amour, de silence et de foi, racontée par deux voix : celle d'un jeune homme de 19 ans, et celle de la rose qu'il a envoyée.

Le film est produit par l'association culturelle All With Heart, avec une ambition claire : le cinéma.

NOUS RECHERCHONS

Rôle principal
• LINA, 18-22 ans. Lumineuse, sensible, pleine d'humour. Elle reçoit les roses et cherche le visage qui se cache derrière. Un regard qui dit tout.

Rôles secondaires
• NADIA, 40-50 ans. La mère de Farès. Discrète, elle voit tout sans rien dire.
• YANIS, 18-23 ans. Le meilleur ami de Farès, le comique de la bande. Le sens du rythme est indispensable.
• ILYES, 18-23 ans. L'autre ami, calme et profond, celui à qui l'on se confie.
• CLAIRE, 42-52 ans. La mère de Lina, sa confidente.
• KARIM, 45-55 ans. Le père de Lina. Protecteur, et maladroit quand il mène sa propre enquête sur les roses.
• NOAM, 16 ans à l'écran (rôle réservé à un comédien majeur). Le petit frère de Lina, malin, le premier à soupçonner Farès.
• THÉO, 18-23 ans. Un garçon de la troupe, dont Farès est jaloux.
• ADAM, 19-24 ans. Celui qui ose dire « tu me plais ».
• LE FLEURISTE, 30-65 ans. Peu de scènes, mais un rôle clé : c'est lui qui tend la petite carte blanche.

Figuration
• De nombreux figurants, notamment pour la troupe d'une comédie musicale. Chant ou danse bienvenus.

Aucun critère physique ni d'origine. Les âges sont indicatifs, et les prénoms des personnages peuvent évoluer selon les comédiens retenus. Débutant ou confirmé, ce que nous cherchons avant tout, c'est la sincérité.

LE PROJET
• Tournage majoritairement en région parisienne.
• Projet associatif non rémunéré. Chaque participant signe une convention de bénévolat et une autorisation d'exploitation de son image et de son interprétation.
• Ce que tu reçois : un rôle dans un long métrage pensé pour le cinéma, ton nom au générique, les images de tes scènes pour ta bande démo, une invitation à l'avant-première, et une équipe exigeante et bienveillante.

POUR CANDIDATER
Inscription uniquement ici : https://casting-une-fleur-sans-nom.vercel.app/
Prépare une photo portrait en lumière naturelle et, si tu peux, une vidéo verticale d'une minute maximum où tu joues un texte de ton choix.

Pendant des semaines, il a envoyé des fleurs sans nom. Cette fois, nous signons.
Une fleur sans nom. Rien de ce qui est beau n'attend.

Bonjour! Nous sommes toujours à la recherche de groupes de potes motivés pour participer à une rave pour un tournage!

Vendredi 30 après midi : Avec le DJ PATATE DOUCE de Lille pour vraiment vous ambiancer et passer une super aprem!

A très vite

Merci pour vos partages!
